ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white (distal lobes) to low-intensity black (central and proximal regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment radiating from the central peduncle across the inner 50% of lobe surface area; high-intensity white contiguous zones on the distal 50% of both lobes with high-contrast, irregular terminal boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; primary peaks identified on the distal right lobe edge with amplitudes of approximately 8-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature on the trailing edge sweeping from the distal tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the extreme terminal tips of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and structural irregularities on the far lateral margins of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-intensity white punctate spots (1-3 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark central peduncle and lower lobe areas.
